summary.text: Jason Howell is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 1, serving since 2021. The legislature's profile lists Howell as chair of the Senate Agriculture Committee and vice chair of its Licensing & Occupations Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Jason Howell was born on December 19, 1970, and is an attorney.
The profile lists a B.A. from the University of the South and a J.D. from the University of Kentucky.
It also lists membership at St. John's Episcopal Church and in the Kentucky and Calloway County bar associations.
